result.topic_en: The page states Ramanujan's theta function φ(q) = 1 + 2q + 2q^4 + 2q^9 + … and the identity φ²(q) + φ²(−q) = 2φ²(q²); the lower half has upside-down pencil work on struck-out quotients and products of factors (1 ± x^n).

methods.what: Definition of the theta function φ(q) as a series over squares
Theta function identity relating φ²(q) + φ²(−q) to φ²(q²)
Products of factors (1 − x^n) and (1 + x^n) written as a quotient (rough work)

items.english: phi squared of q plus phi squared of minus q equals twice phi squared of q squared.
